record.question: Land of Golden Fleece
record.explanation: Answer A: Australia. The National Library of Australia’s object-based historical account is titled The land of the golden fleece: The wool industry in Australia, and explains the wool-industry connection. Australia is the intended geographical nickname. Historical/source note: This is a historical nickname; the mythic Golden Fleece itself belongs to a separate Greek/Colchian story. Reference: https://www.library.gov.au/news-media/land-golden-fleece-wool-industry-australia. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
